claim: The original fifth quotient pullback is an additive equivalence onto the actual invariant global differential summand, with normalized global differential retraction

obligations.name: Hypotheses
obligations.required: The original fifth completed quotient and actual intrinsic global Omega
obligations.constructed: Uses the independently specified original canonical pullback, its proved injectivity and regular range equality
obligations.why_match: No dimension or existence of a Jacobian assumed

obligations.name: Objects
obligations.required: Actual target global differentials and original invariant subgroup of source global differentials
obligations.constructed: The codomain is the previously defined eight-sign invariant AddSubgroup

obligations.name: Coverage
obligations.required: Every actual global section in either stated group
obligations.constructed: Bijectivity uses genuine regular range, including finite branch points and infinity
obligations.why_match: Not only the five-form span or rational coefficients

obligations.name: Maps
obligations.required: Original pullback as the forward additive equivalence
obligations.constructed: AddEquiv.ofBijective packages that exact map with its unique inverse

obligations.name: Normalization
obligations.constructed: The retraction is the inverse actual pullback composed with the original averaging retraction

obligations.name: Identities
obligations.required: Both inverse/retraction identities and exact values on all five known forms
obligations.constructed: Pullback after retraction is the original average; retraction after pullback is identity
obligations.why_match: Fifth pulled invariant returns to its specified target invariant with scalar one

obligations.name: Other components
obligations.constructed: The original average kills each and injectivity proves its transferred value is zero
obligations.why_match: Does not assert these exhaust the kernel

obligations.name: Evidence
obligations.required: Bounded strict source check and recursive target audit
obligations.constructed: One new source and exact predecessor bindings
obligations.why_match: No predecessor replay or hosted acceptance inferred

obligations.name: Boundary
obligations.required: Additive equivalence and normalized transfer on global regular differentials
obligations.constructed: Only global sections of the actual Omega modules
obligations.why_match: No sheaf differential trace, canonical dimension, complete basis, Picard/Jacobian, polarization, PEL or KS result

not_claimed: The four forms exhaust the transfer kernel
